mechanism: Budesonide (corticosteroid) increases sodium retention and potassium depletion, while bumetanide (loop diuretic) causes additional electrolyte losses and hypokalemia, creating additive hypokalemic and fluid retention effects.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium) regularly; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing agent; monitor blood pressure and fluid status periodically.
